title: 호텔 체크인
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 호텔에 도착해서 프런트에서 체크인하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello. I have a reservation under Kim.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Good morning. May I see your passport and confirmation, please?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Sure. Here they are.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Thank you. You booked a double room for three nights. Is that right?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Great. Could you please fill out this form?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Of course.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Your room is 512 on the fifth floor. Breakfast is from 7 to 10.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. What time is check-out?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Check-out is at 11 a.m. Here is your key card.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you!

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 좋은 아침입니다. 여권이랑 예약 확인서 보여 주시겠어요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 좋습니다. 이 양식 좀 작성해 주시겠어요?

practice: I have a reservation under Kim.
subtitle: 호텔에 도착해서 프런트에서 체크인하는 장면

title: 환전소
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 환전소에서 달러를 현지 돈으로 바꾸는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. I'd like to exchange some dollars, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. How much would you like to change?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Two hundred dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Okay. Today's rate is one dollar to one point three five.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That sounds fine. Can I have small bills, please?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Of course. May I see your passport?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here you are.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thank you. Here's your money and your receipt.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 좋아요. 작은 단위 지폐로 주실 수 있어요?

expressions.en: I'd like to exchange some dollars.
How much would you like to change?
Can I have small bills, please?
expressions.ko: 작은 단위 지폐로 주실 수 있어요?

practice: I'd like to exchange some dollars, please.
subtitle: 환전소에서 달러를 현지 돈으로 바꾸는 장면

title: 호텔에서 잃어버린 지갑 찾기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 호텔 프런트에서 잃어버린 지갑을 찾는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. I lost my wallet. Did anyone find it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Where did you lose it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I think in the restaurant, around lunchtime.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: What color is it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's black and small. There's a blue card in it.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Please wait a moment. ... Yes, we found a black wallet. Is this yours?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes! Thank you so much. What should I do now?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Please show your ID, and sign here.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 실례합니다. 지갑을 잃어버렸어요. 혹시 누가 찾은 거 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 검은색이고 작아요. 안에 파란 카드가 있어요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 잠시만요. … 네, 검은 지갑이 있네요. 이거 맞으세요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 네! 정말 감사해요. 이제 어떻게 하면 돼요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 신분증 보여 주시고 여기 서명해 주세요.

practice: I lost my wallet. Did anyone find it?
subtitle: 호텔 프런트에서 잃어버린 지갑을 찾는 장면

title: 버스 타고 박물관 가기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 버스 정류장에서 박물관 가는 버스가 맞는지 물어보고 타는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Does this bus go to the city museum?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.text: Yes, it does. Get on, please.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How much is the fare?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.text: Two dollars. You can pay by card.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Where should I get off?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.text: Get off at Green Park stop. It's about ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. Could you tell me when we get there?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.text: Sure. I'll call it out.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Thanks a lot!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 실례합니다. 이 버스 시립 박물관 가요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 감사합니다. 도착하면 알려 주실 수 있어요?

expressions.en: Could you tell me when we get there?

practice: Does this bus go to the city museum?
subtitle: 버스 정류장에서 박물관 가는 버스가 맞는지 물어보고 타는 장면

title: 기념품 가게
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 기념품 가게에서 엽서랑 티셔츠를 사는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. How much is this postcard?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: It's two dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: And this T-shirt?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: That's fifteen dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do you have a smaller size?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Yes. Here you are.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. I'll take the postcard and the T-shirt.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Would you like a bag?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Of course.

expressions.en: Do you have a smaller size?

practice: Do you have a smaller size?
subtitle: 기념품 가게에서 엽서랑 티셔츠를 사는 장면

title: 호텔 세탁 서비스
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 호텔 프런트에서 세탁 서비스를 물어보고 옷을 맡기는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Do you have a laundry service?

dialogue.speaker: Front desk
dialogue.text: Yes, we do. Would you like same-day or next-day service?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Same-day, please. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Front desk
dialogue.text: It's ten dollars per shirt, and fifteen for pants.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Can I get these back by six o'clock?

dialogue.speaker: Front desk
dialogue.text: Yes. Please fill out this form and leave your clothes in the bag.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. Where should I leave the bag?

dialogue.speaker: Front desk
dialogue.text: Just put it outside your door before ten in the morning.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네, 있어요. 당일 서비스로 하실래요, 다음 날 서비스로 하실래요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네. 이 양식을 작성하시고 옷은 가방에 넣어 주세요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 오전 10시 전에 방문 밖에 두시면 돼요.

expressions.en: Do you have a laundry service?
Can I get these back by six o'clock?

practice: Can I get these back by six o'clock?
subtitle: 호텔 프런트에서 세탁 서비스를 물어보고 옷을 맡기는 장면

title: 렌터카 빌리기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 렌터카 카운터에서 예약한 차를 빌리는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. I have a reservation. My name is Kim.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. Can I see your passport and driver's license?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here you are. What car do I get?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: A compact car. Do you want full insurance?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, please. How much is the deposit?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's $200. You get it back when you return the car.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. When should I return it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Tomorrow by 5 p.m., with a full tank.

practice: How much is the deposit?
subtitle: 렌터카 카운터에서 예약한 차를 빌리는 장면

title: 여행용 SIM 카드
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 공항에 내리자마자 통신사 매장에서 여행용 SIM 카드를 사는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. I need a SIM card for my phone.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. How long are you staying?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: About one week.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: This plan has 10 GB of data for seven days. It's 25 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Does it include calls?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, local calls are included.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. I'll take it.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Can I see your passport, please?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here you are.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thanks. Is your phone unlocked?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I think so. Can you put the SIM card in for me?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: No problem. ... Okay, it's working now.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. Is there free Wi-Fi here, too?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes. The password is on this card.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요. 휴대폰에 쓸 SIM 카드가 필요해요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 그런 것 같아요. SIM 카드 좀 끼워 주실 수 있어요?

expressions.en: I need a SIM card for my phone.

expressions.ko: 얼마나 머무세요? (여행 중에 자주 듣는 질문)

expressions.en: Can you put ~ in for me?

practice: Can you put the SIM card in for me?
subtitle: 공항에 내리자마자 통신사 매장에서 여행용 SIM 카드를 사는 장면

title: 수하물 분실 신고
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 공항 수하물 찾는 곳에서 캐리어가 안 나와서 직원한테 분실 신고하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, my suitcase didn't come out.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. What flight were you on?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Flight 17 from Seoul. Here's my baggage tag.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thank you. What does your bag look like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's a big black suitcase with a red ribbon.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Let me check. Your bag is still in Seoul.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oh no. When will it get here?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It'll come on the next flight, tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can you send it to my hotel?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. Please write your hotel address and phone number here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: OK. Can I get anything for tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes. Here's a small kit with a toothbrush and a T-shirt.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. How can I check on my bag?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Use this reference number on our website.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 빨간 리본 달린 큰 검은색 캐리어예요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 확인해 볼게요. 가방이 아직 서울에 있네요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 다음 비행기로 내일 아침에 올 거예요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 제 호텔로 보내 주실 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 그럼요. 여기에 호텔 주소랑 전화번호 적어 주세요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 네. 오늘 밤에 쓸 거 좀 받을 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네. 칫솔이랑 티셔츠 든 작은 키트 여기 있어요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 저희 웹사이트에서 이 조회 번호로 확인하시면 돼요.

expressions.en: What does your bag look like?
Can you send it to my hotel?
expressions.ko: 제 호텔로 보내 주실 수 있어요?

expressions.en: How can I check on my bag?

practice: Can you send it to my hotel?
subtitle: 공항 수하물 찾는 곳에서 캐리어가 안 나와서 직원한테 분실 신고하는 장면

title: 기차 왕복표
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 기차역 매표소에서 왕복표를 사는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Hi, where are you going today?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. One ticket to Oxford, please.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: One way or return?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Return, please. I'm coming back tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you want to leave now or later?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What time is the next train?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: The next one leaves at 10:15 from platform 4.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: It's 28 pounds for an off-peak return.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Sure. Just tap here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do I need to change trains?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: No, it's a direct train. It takes about one hour.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. Thank you!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요. 옥스퍼드 가는 표 한 장 주세요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네. 지금 바로 가실 거예요, 나중에 가실 거예요?

expressions.en: What time is the next train?
Do I need to change trains?

practice: Do I need to change trains?
subtitle: 기차역 매표소에서 왕복표를 사는 장면

title: 입국심사
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 공항에 도착해서 입국심사 받는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Good morning. Passport, please.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here you go.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: What's the purpose of your visit?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'm here for sightseeing.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: How long are you staying?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: For seven days.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Where are you staying?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: At the Grand Hotel downtown.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Is this your first time here?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, it's my first time.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Do you have a return ticket?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. Here's my e-ticket.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Thank you. Enjoy your stay.

expressions.en: What's the purpose of your visit?

practice: I'm here for sightseeing. I'm staying for seven days.
subtitle: 공항에 도착해서 입국심사 받는 장면

title: 관광안내소
intro: 오늘 아침 거는 좀 늦었어, 미안. 오늘은 관광안내소에서 지도를 받고 근처 갈 만한 곳을 물어보는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Is this the tourist information center?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'd like a map of the city, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. Here you are. Are you looking for anything special?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. What places do you recommend near here?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: The old town is nice. It's about fifteen minutes on foot.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How late is it open?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Until six o'clock today.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I walk there, or should I take a bus?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: You can walk. Go straight, then turn left at the big church.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you so much.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Have a good day!

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네, 여기요. 특별히 찾는 데 있으세요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 네. 이 근처에 추천하는 곳 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 걸어가도 돼요, 아니면 버스 타야 돼요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 걸어가셔도 돼요. 직진하다가 큰 교회에서 왼쪽으로 도세요.

expressions.en: I'd like a map of the city.
What places do you recommend near here?

practice: What places do you recommend near here?
subtitle: 관광안내소에서 지도를 받고 근처 갈 만한 곳을 물어보는 장면

title: 식당에서 계산서 나누기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 친구 둘이랑 식당에서 먹고 계산서를 따로 나눠 달라고 하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, can we get the check, please?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.text: Sure. Is it one check or separate checks?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Separate checks, please. There are three of us.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.text: No problem. What did each person have?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I had the pasta and a Coke.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.text: Okay. And your friends?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: She had the salad, and he had the steak.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.text: Got it. Here are your three checks.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. Is the tip included?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.text: No, it's not included.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.text: Yes, of course. Just tap here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. Everything was delicious.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.text: Thank you! Have a nice day.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네. 한 번에 계산하실까요, 따로 하실까요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 따로 해 주세요. 저희 세 명이에요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 이 친구는 샐러드, 저 친구는 스테이크요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 알겠습니다. 계산서 세 장 여기 있어요.

expressions.en: Can we get the check, please?

practice: Separate checks, please. There are three of us.
subtitle: 친구 둘이랑 식당에서 먹고 계산서를 따로 나눠 달라고 하는 장면

title: 룸서비스
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 호텔 방에서 룸서비스에 전화해서 음식을 시키는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Room service, how can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to order some food to my room.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. What's your room number?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's room 412.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thank you. What would you like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: One club sandwich and a bowl of tomato soup, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Would you like anything to drink?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, a bottle of sparkling water, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: No problem. It will take about 30 minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Can I put it on my room bill?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, we'll add it to your room.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Can you also bring an extra spoon?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Of course. Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, that's all. Thank you!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요, 방으로 음식 좀 시키고 싶어요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 클럽 샌드위치 하나랑 토마토 수프 한 그릇 주세요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 네. 방값에 같이 달아 줄 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 좋아요. 숟가락도 하나 더 갖다줄 수 있어요?

expressions.en: Can I put it on my room bill?
expressions.ko: 방값에 같이 달아 줄 수 있어요?

practice: Can I put it on my room bill?
subtitle: 호텔 방에서 룸서비스에 전화해서 음식을 시키는 장면

title: 패스트푸드 주문
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 패스트푸드점 카운터에서 세트 메뉴를 주문하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Hi, what can I get for you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. Can I get a cheeseburger meal, please?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. Medium or large?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Medium, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: What drink would you like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A Coke, please. No ice.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: For here or to go?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: For here.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I have some extra ketchup?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Of course. That's $9.50.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. Tap here. Your number is 23.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 케첩 좀 더 주실 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네. 여기 대 주세요. 주문 번호는 23번이에요.

practice: Can I get a cheeseburger meal, please?
subtitle: 패스트푸드점 카운터에서 세트 메뉴를 주문하는 장면

title: 공항 보안 검색
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 공항 보안 검색대에서 가방, 노트북, 액체류 검사를 받는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Where do I put my bag?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Put your bag on the belt, please.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Should I take out my laptop?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Yes. Please take out your laptop and liquids.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How about my jacket?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Please take off your jacket and shoes too.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is this bottle okay?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Sorry. Liquids over 100 milliliters are not allowed.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll throw it away.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Please walk through the metal detector.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I go now?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Yes. You can go. Have a nice flight!

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네. 가셔도 돼요. 좋은 비행 되세요!

expressions.en: Put your bag on the belt.
Take out your laptop and liquids.
Take off your jacket and shoes.

practice: Should I take out my laptop?
subtitle: 공항 보안 검색대에서 가방, 노트북, 액체류 검사를 받는 장면

title: 사진 부탁하기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 관광지에서 지나가는 사람한테 사진을 부탁하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Could you take a photo of us, please?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: Of course! Where should I stand?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Right here is fine. Can you get the building behind us?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: Okay. Say cheese!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: One more, please? A little farther back.

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: Sure. Ready? One, two, three.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That looks great. Thank you so much!

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Enjoy your trip!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 실례합니다. 저희 사진 좀 찍어 주실 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 여기면 돼요. 뒤에 건물도 나오게 찍어 주실 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 한 장만 더요? 조금만 더 뒤에서요.

expressions.en: Could you take a photo of us, please?
expressions.ko: 저희 사진 좀 찍어 주실 수 있어요?

expressions.en: Can you get the building behind us?
expressions.ko: 뒤에 건물도 나오게 찍어 주실 수 있어요?

practice: Could you take a photo of us, please?
subtitle: 관광지에서 지나가는 사람한테 사진을 부탁하는 장면

title: 에어비앤비 체크인
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 에어비앤비 숙소에 도착해서 호스트한테 체크인하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: Hi! You must be Jaesung. Welcome!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi! Yes, nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you too. Was it easy to find the place?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, the map was really helpful.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: Great. Here are your keys. This one is for the front door.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. What's the Wi-Fi password?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: It's on the card by the TV.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Got it. Where can I put the trash?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: There are bins under the sink. Please separate the recycling.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. What time is check-out?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: Eleven in the morning. Just leave the keys on the table.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. Is there a supermarket nearby?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: Yes, there's one around the corner. It's open until ten at night.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks so much!

meaning.speaker: 호스트
meaning.text: 안녕하세요! 재성 씨 맞죠? 어서 와요!

meaning.speaker: 호스트
meaning.text: 다행이네요. 여기 열쇠요. 이건 현관문 열쇠예요.

meaning.speaker: 호스트
meaning.text: TV 옆에 있는 카드에 적혀 있어요.

meaning.speaker: 호스트
meaning.text: 싱크대 밑에 쓰레기통이 있어요. 재활용은 따로 분리해 주세요.

meaning.speaker: 호스트
meaning.text: 오전 11시요. 열쇠는 그냥 테이블에 두고 가면 돼요.

meaning.speaker: 호스트
meaning.text: 네, 모퉁이 돌면 하나 있어요. 밤 10시까지 해요.

expressions.ko: ~ 씨 맞죠? (처음 만난 사람 확인할 때)

expressions.en: Where can I put the trash?

practice: Where can I put the trash?
subtitle: 에어비앤비 숙소에 도착해서 호스트한테 체크인하는 장면

title: 당일 투어 예약
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 호텔 투어 데스크에서 내일 당일 투어를 예약하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Hi! How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. I want to book a day tour for tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. We have a city tour and a mountain tour.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How long is the mountain tour?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: About eight hours. It starts at 8 a.m.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is lunch included?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, lunch and water are included.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's 75 dollars per person.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Where does the bus pick us up?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: In front of your hotel, at 7:45.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Two people, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Can I have your name and phone number?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Sure. My name is Jaesung Ko.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요. 내일 당일 투어 예약하고 싶어요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네. 시티 투어랑 산 투어가 있어요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 좋아요. 버스는 어디서 저희 태워 가요?

practice: Where does the bus pick us up?
subtitle: 호텔 투어 데스크에서 내일 당일 투어를 예약하는 장면

title: 렌터카 반납
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 여행 마지막 날 렌터카 카운터에서 차를 반납하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Hi! Are you returning a car?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. Here are the keys.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thank you. Did you fill up the gas tank?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, I filled it up this morning.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Great. Let me check the car quickly.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. There's a small scratch on the back door. It was there before.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Let me see... Yes, it's on the form. No problem.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good. Is there any extra charge?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: No, everything looks fine. You're right on time.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Can I get a receipt?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. I'll email it to you.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. Where can I catch the shuttle to the airport?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's right outside. It comes every fifteen minutes.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 네. 뒷문에 작은 긁힌 자국이 있는데, 원래 있던 거예요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 어디 보자… 네, 서류에 적혀 있네요. 괜찮아요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 아니요, 다 괜찮아요. 딱 제시간에 오셨네요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 고마워요. 공항 가는 셔틀은 어디서 타요?

expressions.ko: 원래 있던 거예요. (내가 낸 게 아니라고 말할 때)

expressions.en: Where can I catch the shuttle?

practice: There's a small scratch on the back door. It was there before.
subtitle: 여행 마지막 날 렌터카 카운터에서 차를 반납하는 장면

title: 놀이공원 티켓
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 놀이공원 매표소에서 티켓 사는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, two adult tickets for today, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. One-day pass or evening pass?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What's the difference?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: The one-day pass is all day. The evening pass starts at five in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: One-day pass, please. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's sixty dollars per person. So that's one hundred twenty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Does it include all the rides?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, all rides are included. But the fast pass is extra.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's okay. We don't need it.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Here are your tickets. Please keep them with you.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. What time does the parade start?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: At three o'clock, on Main Street.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Where can I get a map?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Right over there, next to the gate. Have fun!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요, 오늘 성인 티켓 두 장 주세요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네, 놀이기구는 다 포함이에요. 근데 패스트패스는 따로예요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 바로 저기 입구 옆이요. 재밌게 노세요!

practice: Does it include all the rides?
subtitle: 놀이공원 매표소에서 티켓 사는 장면

title: 빵집에서 빵 사기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 여행 중 아침에 동네 빵집에서 빵을 사서 포장해 가는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi! What's good today?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: The croissants are fresh. They just came out of the oven.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Can I get two croissants, please?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What's this one?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: That's a blueberry muffin. It's very popular.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll take one muffin too.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: For here or to go?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: To go, please. Can you put them in separate bags?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: No problem. That's $9.50.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Of course. Just tap here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. Have a nice day!

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: You too!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 가져갈게요. 봉투에 따로따로 담아 주실 수 있어요?

expressions.en: It just came out of the oven.
Can you put them in separate bags?
expressions.ko: 봉투에 따로 담아 주실 수 있어요?

practice: Can you put them in separate bags?
subtitle: 여행 중 아침에 동네 빵집에서 빵을 사서 포장해 가는 장면

title: 병원 진료
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 여행 중에 몸이 안 좋아서 병원에 가는 장면이야. 접수하고 의사한테 진료받는 데까지 가.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, I don't feel well. Can I see a doctor today?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Sure. Do you have travel insurance?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, here's my insurance card and passport.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Thanks. Please fill out this form and take a seat.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Hello. What seems to be the problem?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I have a sore throat and a fever. It started last night.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Do you have a cough or a headache?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Just a little cough. No headache.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Let me check your throat. Say "ah."

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: It's a mild throat infection. I'll give you some medicine.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How often should I take it?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Twice a day after meals, for five days.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I still go sightseeing?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes, but rest well and drink lots of water.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요, 몸이 안 좋아요. 오늘 진료받을 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 접수 직원
meaning.text: 감사합니다. 이 양식 작성하시고 앉아서 기다려 주세요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 목이 아프고 열이 나요. 어젯밤부터 그래요.

meaning.speaker: 의사
meaning.text: 가벼운 목 감염이에요. 약 처방해 드릴게요.

meaning.speaker: 의사
meaning.text: 하루 두 번 식후에, 5일 동안 드세요.

meaning.speaker: 의사
meaning.text: 네, 근데 푹 쉬고 물 많이 드세요.

expressions.en: What seems to be the problem?
How often should I take it?

practice: I have a sore throat and a fever. It started last night.
subtitle: 여행 중에 몸이 안 좋아서 병원에 가는 장면

title: 지연된 항공편
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 공항 게이트에서 비행기가 늦어졌을 때 직원한테 물어보는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is the flight to Bangkok delayed?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, it's delayed by about two hours.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oh no. What's the new departure time?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's now 3:40 p.m. Boarding starts at 3:10.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is it still at this gate?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, Gate 24. But please check the screen for changes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I have a connecting flight. Will I miss it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Let me check. Your next flight is at 9 p.m. You'll have enough time.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's good. Can I get anything for the delay?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, here's a meal voucher for fifteen dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Where can I use it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: At any restaurant in this area.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Thank you for your help.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Sorry for the wait.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네, 24번 게이트요. 그래도 바뀔 수 있으니 화면 확인해 주세요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 확인해 볼게요. 다음 비행기가 밤 9시네요. 시간 충분해요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 다행이네요. 늦어진 거 보상 같은 거 있어요?

practice: Excuse me, is the flight to Bangkok delayed?
subtitle: 공항 게이트에서 비행기가 늦어졌을 때 직원한테 물어보는 장면

title: 경찰서 도난 신고
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 여행 중에 가방을 도둑맞아서 경찰서에 신고하러 가는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Hello. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. Someone stole my bag.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Where did it happen?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: At a café near the market.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: What time was it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: About two hours ago, around 1 p.m.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: What was in your bag?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: My wallet, my phone, and my passport.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Okay. What does the bag look like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's a small black backpack.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Please fill out this form. We'll give you a police report.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. I need it for my travel insurance.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Also, call your embassy about the passport.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, I will. Thanks for your help.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요. 누가 제 가방을 훔쳐 갔어요.

meaning.speaker: 경찰
meaning.text: 이 양식 작성해 주세요. 경찰 신고서 떼어 드릴게요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 감사합니다. 여행자 보험 때문에 그게 필요해요.

practice: Someone stole my bag. I need a police report for my travel insurance.
subtitle: 여행 중에 가방을 도둑맞아서 경찰서에 신고하러 가는 장면

title: 슈퍼마켓 계산
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 여행 중에 슈퍼마켓 계산대에서 계산하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.text: Hi, did you find everything okay?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, thanks. Do you sell bags?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.text: Yes, a bag is 10 cents. How many do you need?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Just one, please.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.text: Do you have a store card?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, I don't. I'm just visiting.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.text: No problem. Oh, this water is on sale. Buy one, get one free.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Really? Then I'll get one more.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.text: Sure, go ahead. I'll wait.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks! Here you go.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.text: Your total is $12.40.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.text: Of course. Just tap here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I have the receipt, please?

meaning.speaker: 계산원
meaning.text: 괜찮아요. 아, 이 물 세일 중이에요. 하나 사면 하나 공짜예요.

expressions.en: Can I have the receipt, please?

practice: No, I don't. I'm just visiting.
subtitle: 여행 중에 슈퍼마켓 계산대에서 계산하는 장면

title: 호텔 조식 문의
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 호텔 프런트에서 조식 시간이랑 장소, 방값에 포함됐는지 물어보는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, I have a question about breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. What would you like to know?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What time is breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's from 6:30 to 10:00 every morning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Where is the breakfast room?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's on the second floor, next to the elevator.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is breakfast included in my room?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Let me check. What's your room number?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, breakfast is included for two people.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Is there a vegetarian option?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, we have salad, fruit, eggs, and fresh bread.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I get coffee to go?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Of course. Just ask the staff in the breakfast room.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요, 조식 관련해서 물어볼 게 있어요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 확인해 볼게요. 방 번호가 어떻게 되세요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네, 샐러드, 과일, 달걀, 갓 구운 빵이 있어요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 그럼요. 조식 식당 직원한테 말씀하시면 돼요.

practice: Is breakfast included in my room?
subtitle: 호텔 프런트에서 조식 시간이랑 장소, 방값에 포함됐는지 물어보는 장면

title: 미용실
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 여행 중에 예약 없이 미용실에 가서 머리 자르는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Hi! Do you have an appointment?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, I don't. Can I get a haircut now?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. We can see you in 10 minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. How much is a haircut?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's $25. How would you like it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Just a little shorter, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Shorter on the sides, too?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, short on the sides, but not too short on top.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: No problem. Do you want a wash?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: All done. How does it look?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It looks great. Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: You're welcome. You can pay at the front.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 아니요. 지금 머리 자를 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 네, 옆은 짧게, 근데 윗머리는 너무 짧지 않게요.

practice: Just a little shorter, please.
subtitle: 여행 중에 예약 없이 미용실에 가서 머리 자르는 장면

title: 충전기 사기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 여행 중에 충전기를 잃어버려서 전자제품 매장에서 새로 사는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Hi, can I help you find something?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, I need a charger for my phone.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. What phone do you have?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's this one. It uses a USB-C cable.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you need just the cable, or the plug too?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Both, please. My plug doesn't fit here.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: This set has a cable and a plug. It's twenty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Does it charge fast?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, it's a fast charger.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is the cable long?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's one meter. We also have a two-meter one for five dollars more.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: One meter is fine. I'll take it. Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. Just tap here.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 둘 다요. 제 플러그가 여기 콘센트에 안 맞아요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 이 세트에 케이블이랑 플러그가 같이 있어요. 20달러예요.

expressions.en: I need a charger for my phone.
Do you need just A, or B too?

practice: I need a charger for my phone. It uses a USB-C cable.
subtitle: 여행 중에 충전기를 잃어버려서 전자제품 매장에서 새로 사는 장면

title: 페리 왕복표
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 항구 매표소에서 섬 가는 페리 왕복표 두 장을 사는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like two tickets to the island, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. One way or round trip?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Round trip, please. When is the next ferry?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: The next one leaves at 10:30.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How long does it take?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: About 40 minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's $18 per person, so $36 in total.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, of course.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What time is the last ferry back?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: At 6 p.m. Please don't miss it.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Got it. Where do we get on?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: At Pier 3. Boarding starts 15 minutes before.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요, 섬 가는 표 두 장 주세요.

expressions.en: What time is the last ferry back?

practice: Round trip, please. When is the next ferry?
subtitle: 항구 매표소에서 섬 가는 페리 왕복표 두 장을 사는 장면

title: 자전거 대여
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 자전거 대여점에서 자전거를 빌리는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to rent a bike, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. For how long?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: For about three hours. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's five dollars an hour, so fifteen dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Is a helmet included?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, the helmet and a lock are free.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Do you need my ID?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, I need your passport or a credit card.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here's my credit card.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thanks. Please bring the bike back by two o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Got it. Is there a good bike path near here?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, go right. There's a nice path along the river.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Have fun, and ride safe!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 알겠어요. 근처에 괜찮은 자전거 길 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네, 오른쪽으로 가세요. 강 따라 좋은 길이 있어요.

expressions.en: I'd like to rent a bike.

practice: I'd like to rent a bike for three hours, please.
subtitle: 자전거 대여점에서 자전거를 빌리는 장면

title: 야시장 길거리 음식
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 야시장 노점에서 길거리 음식을 주문하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Vendor
dialogue.text: Hi! What can I get you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. What's good here?

dialogue.speaker: Vendor
dialogue.text: The chicken skewers are popular. The noodles too.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Are the noodles spicy?

dialogue.speaker: Vendor
dialogue.text: A little. I can make them not spicy.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Not spicy, please. One bowl of noodles and two chicken skewers.

dialogue.speaker: Vendor
dialogue.text: Sure. Anything to drink?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A mango juice, please. How much is it all?

dialogue.speaker: Vendor
dialogue.text: That's eleven dollars. Cash only, sorry.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No problem. Here's fifteen.

dialogue.speaker: Vendor
dialogue.text: Here's four dollars change. Ready in five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I eat here?

dialogue.speaker: Vendor
dialogue.text: Sure. The tables are over there.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks!

meaning.speaker: 상인
meaning.text: 조금요. 안 맵게 해 드릴 수 있어요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안 맵게 해 주세요. 국수 한 그릇이랑 닭꼬치 두 개요.

practice: Not spicy, please. One bowl of noodles and two chicken skewers.
subtitle: 야시장 노점에서 길거리 음식을 주문하는 장면

title: 우체국에서 엽서 보내기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 여행 중에 우체국에서 한국으로 엽서를 보내는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Hi, how can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. I want to send this postcard to Korea.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Sure. Do you need a stamp?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, please. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: It's two dollars for one postcard.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I have three postcards.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Then it's six dollars in total.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How long does it take to get there?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: About one or two weeks.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is there a faster way?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Yes, express mail. But it's fifteen dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's okay. Normal mail is fine.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Here are your stamps. You can put them in that box over there.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks a lot!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요. 이 엽서 한국으로 보내고 싶어요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 우표 여기요. 저쪽 우체통에 넣으시면 돼요.

expressions.en: I want to send this to ~.

practice: How long does it take to get there?
subtitle: 여행 중에 우체국에서 한국으로 엽서를 보내는 장면

title: 잘못된 주문
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 식당에서 주문이 잘못 나와서 직원한테 말하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I think this is the wrong order.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Oh, I'm sorry. What did you order?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I ordered the chicken pasta, not the beef.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: You're right. I'm so sorry about that.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's okay. Also, I asked for no onions.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Got it. Chicken pasta with no onions.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How long will it take?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: About ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, no problem.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Can I bring you a free drink while you wait?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's very kind. A lemonade, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. Sorry again for the mistake.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 저기요, 주문이 잘못 나온 것 같아요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 괜찮아요. 그리고 양파 빼 달라고 했어요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 기다리시는 동안 음료 하나 서비스로 드릴까요?

expressions.en: I think this is the wrong order.

practice: Excuse me, I think this is the wrong order.
subtitle: 식당에서 주문이 잘못 나와서 직원한테 말하는 장면

title: 기내 서비스
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 비행기 안에서 승무원한테 음료, 식사, 담요를 부탁하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Flight attendant
dialogue.text: Hello. Would you like something to drink?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, can I have some orange juice, please?

dialogue.speaker: Flight attendant
dialogue.text: Sure. Here you go. For dinner, we have chicken or fish.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'll have the chicken, please.

dialogue.speaker: Flight attendant
dialogue.text: Okay. Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I get a blanket? It's a little cold.

dialogue.speaker: Flight attendant
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll bring one right away.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. Also, when do we land?

dialogue.speaker: Flight attendant
dialogue.text: We land in about three hours.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do I need to fill out an arrival card?

dialogue.speaker: Flight attendant
dialogue.text: Yes. I'll give you one with your meal.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Can I have a pen, too?

dialogue.speaker: Flight attendant
dialogue.text: Sure, here's a pen.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks a lot.

meaning.speaker: 승무원
meaning.text: 네, 여기요. 저녁은 치킨이랑 생선이 있어요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 담요 하나 받을 수 있어요? 좀 추워서요.

meaning.speaker: 승무원
meaning.text: 네. 식사 드릴 때 같이 드릴게요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 좋아요. 펜도 하나 주실 수 있어요?

practice: Can I get a blanket? It's a little cold.
subtitle: 비행기 안에서 승무원한테 음료, 식사, 담요를 부탁하는 장면

title: 시장에서 흥정하기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 야외 시장 노점에서 마음에 드는 스카프 값을 깎아 보는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how much is this scarf?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: It's twenty dollars. It's real silk.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's a bit expensive. Can you give me a discount?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Okay, eighteen dollars for you.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How about twelve?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Twelve is too low. Fifteen is my best price.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What if I buy two?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Two for twenty-six dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Twenty-five, and it's a deal.

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Okay, twenty-five.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great! Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Sorry, cash only.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No problem. Here you go.

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Thank you! Have a nice day.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 좀 비싸네요. 좀 깎아 주실 수 있어요?

expressions.en: Can you give me a discount?

practice: That's a bit expensive. Can you give me a discount?
subtitle: 야외 시장 노점에서 마음에 드는 스카프 값을 깎아 보는 장면

title: 호텔 수영장과 헬스장
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 호텔 프런트에서 수영장이랑 헬스장 쓰는 법을 물어보는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, is there a pool in this hotel?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, we have a pool on the 5th floor.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. What time does it open?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's open from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do I need to pay for it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: No, it's free for hotel guests.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I get a towel there?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, towels are by the door.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is there a gym too?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, the gym is next to the pool. It's open 24 hours.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do I need my room key?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, please use your key card to open the door.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, thanks a lot!

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Enjoy your swim!

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네, 키 카드로 문 여시면 돼요.

expressions.en: Is there a ~ in this hotel?

practice: Is there a gym in this hotel?
subtitle: 호텔 프런트에서 수영장이랑 헬스장 쓰는 법을 물어보는 장면

title: 비행기 놓치고 일정 변경
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 비행기를 놓쳐서 공항 항공사 카운터에서 다음 편으로 바꾸는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, I missed my flight to Tokyo. Can you help me?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. Can I see your passport and ticket?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here you go. My train was late.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. The next flight is at 6:15 this evening.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is there anything earlier?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: No, sorry. That's the only one today.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: OK. Do I have to pay extra?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, there's a change fee of 50 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Of course. Here's your new boarding pass.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What about my bag?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: You can check it in here now.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Which gate is it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Gate 12. Boarding starts at 5:35.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요, 도쿄 가는 비행기를 놓쳤어요. 도와주실 수 있어요?

expressions.en: Do I have to pay extra?

practice: I missed my flight. Is there anything earlier?
subtitle: 비행기를 놓쳐서 공항 항공사 카운터에서 다음 편으로 바꾸는 장면

title: 길에서 도움 청하기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 길에서 친구가 넘어져 발목을 다쳐서, 지나가던 현지인한테 도움을 청하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me! Can you help me, please?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: Sure. What's wrong?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: My friend fell down. She hurt her ankle.

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: Oh no. Can she walk?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, she can't. It really hurts.

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you want me to call an ambulance?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, please. I don't have a local phone number.

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: No problem. I'm calling now.

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: They're coming. They'll be here in ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you so much. Where are we exactly?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: We're on Park Street, near the big bank.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. You're very kind.

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: You're welcome. I'll wait with you.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 네, 부탁해요. 저는 현지 전화번호가 없어요.

expressions.en: Do you want me to call an ambulance?

practice: My friend fell down. Can you call an ambulance, please?
subtitle: 길에서 친구가 넘어져 발목을 다쳐서, 지나가던 현지인한테 도움을 청하는 장면

title: 스파 마사지 예약
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 여행하다 피곤해서 스파에 들러 오늘 오후 마사지를 예약하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Hello, welcome to Lotus Spa. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. I'd like to book a massage, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. What kind of massage would you like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What do you recommend?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Our foot massage and full body massage are popular.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'll take a full body massage. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's 60 dollars for one hour.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you have any time this afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: We have an opening at 3 o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. I'll book that, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Do you like soft or strong pressure?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Medium, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Okay. Please come 10 minutes early.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No problem. See you at 3.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 발 마사지랑 전신 마사지가 인기 많아요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 압은 약한 게 좋으세요, 센 게 좋으세요?

practice: Do you have any time this afternoon?
subtitle: 여행하다 피곤해서 스파에 들러 오늘 오후 마사지를 예약하는 장면

title: 호스텔 체크아웃
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 호스텔에서 체크아웃하고 짐을 맡기는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, I’d like to check out, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. What’s your room number?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Room twelve. Here’s my key card.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thanks. Checkout is by ten. You’re right on time.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I leave my bag here until this evening?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes. We can keep it until six. Here’s a luggage tag.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is there any extra charge?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: No. And your deposit will be refunded to your card.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Can I have a receipt, please?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Of course. Have a nice day!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 오늘 저녁까지 여기 짐을 맡길 수 있나요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네. 6시까지 보관해 드릴게요. 여기 짐 보관표예요.

expressions.en: Can I leave my bag here?
Can I have a receipt, please?

practice: Can I leave my bag here until this evening?
subtitle: 호스텔에서 체크아웃하고 짐을 맡기는 장면

title: 영화표 사기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 영화관 매표소에서 영화표를 사는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, two tickets for the seven o'clock movie, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. Which movie?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: The Last Train. Is it in English?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. Where do you want to sit?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: In the middle, please. Not too close to the screen.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: How about row F, seats ten and eleven?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Twelve dollars each, so twenty-four dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Of course. Do you want popcorn or a drink?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: One large popcorn and two Cokes, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: That's nine dollars more. Your movie is in theater three.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. What time does it end?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Around nine fifteen. Enjoy the movie!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요. 7시 영화 표 두 장 주세요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 가운데로 주세요. 화면에 너무 가깝지 않게요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 큰 팝콘 하나랑 콜라 두 개 주세요.

expressions.en: Two tickets for the seven o'clock movie, please.
Not too close to the screen.

practice: In the middle, please. Not too close to the screen.
subtitle: 영화관 매표소에서 영화표를 사는 장면

title: 코인 세탁소
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 코인 세탁소에서 빨래하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how do I use this washer?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: Put your clothes in and add soap.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: The big washer is four dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do you take cards?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: No, only coins. There's a change machine by the door.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Where can I buy soap?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: The soap machine is over there. It's one dollar.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How long does it take?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: The wash takes thirty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: And the dryer?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: Twenty-five minutes for two dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you so much!

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: No problem. There's a folding table by the sink.

meaning.speaker: 현지인
meaning.text: 아니요, 동전만 돼요. 문 옆에 동전 교환기가 있어요.

meaning.speaker: 현지인
meaning.text: 천만에요. 싱크대 옆에 빨래를 개는 테이블이 있어요.

expressions.en: How do I use this washer?

practice: How long does it take?
subtitle: 코인 세탁소에서 빨래하는 장면

title: 전화로 식당 예약
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 식당에 전화해서 오늘 저녁 4명 자리를 예약하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Hello, Blue Garden Restaurant. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to book a table for four tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. What time would you like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Seven o'clock, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, we're full at seven. Is seven thirty okay?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, seven thirty is fine. Can we have a table by the window?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: I'll try. Can I have your name, please?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Jaesung. J-A-E-S-U-N-G.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: And your phone number?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thank you. Please come on time. We keep the table for fifteen minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No problem. Thank you. See you tonight!

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 여보세요, 블루 가든 식당입니다. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요. 오늘 밤 4명 자리를 예약하고 싶어요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 네, 7시 30분 괜찮아요. 창가 자리로 할 수 있을까요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 감사합니다. 시간 맞춰 와 주세요. 자리는 15분 동안만 잡아 둬요.

expressions.en: I'd like to book a table for four.
Can we have a table by the window?
Can I have your name, please?
We keep the table for fifteen minutes.

practice: I'd like to book a table for four tonight.
subtitle: 식당에 전화해서 오늘 저녁 4명 자리를 예약하는 장면

title: 면세점에서 향수 사기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 공항 면세점에서 향수를 사는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where can I find perfume?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's on the left, next to the chocolate.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How much is this one?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's fifty dollars. It's tax-free.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes. May I see your passport and boarding pass?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here you go.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thank you. Which gate are you flying from?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Gate twenty-two, at ten fifty.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Great. Would you like a bag?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Here's your receipt. Have a nice flight!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you!

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네. 여권이랑 탑승권 좀 보여 주시겠어요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 영수증 여기 있어요. 즐거운 비행 되세요!

expressions.en: May I see your passport and boarding pass?
Which gate are you flying from?

practice: Excuse me, where can I find perfume?
subtitle: 공항 면세점에서 향수를 사는 장면

title: 빵집에서 포장하기
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 아침에 빵집에서 크루아상이랑 샌드위치를 포장해 가는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Good morning! What can I get for you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. Are the croissants fresh?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Yes, they just came out of the oven.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. I'll have two croissants, please.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. One chicken sandwich, please.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Sure. For here or to go?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: To go, please.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: That's seven dollars in total.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Of course. Here is your bag. Have a nice day!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. You too!

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 물론이죠. 봉투 여기 있어요. 좋은 하루 보내세요!

practice: I'll have two croissants, please.
subtitle: 아침에 빵집에서 크루아상이랑 샌드위치를 포장해 가는 장면

title: 병원 접수
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 여행 중에 몸이 안 좋아서 병원 접수처에서 진료를 신청하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Hello. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. I don't feel well. I'd like to see a doctor.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: What's wrong?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I have a fever and a sore throat.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Since when?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Since yesterday. I also have a cough.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Do you have any allergies?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. I'm allergic to penicillin.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: OK. The doctor can see you in twenty minutes. Please fill out this form.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Sure. Do I need to pay now?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: No, you can pay after the visit.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Can I have some water, please?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Of course. Here you are.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요. 몸이 안 좋아요. 진료를 받고 싶어요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 알겠습니다. 20분 후에 진료 보실 수 있어요. 이 양식을 작성해 주세요.

expressions.en: I have a fever / a sore throat / a cough.
expressions.ko: 열이 나요 / 목이 아파요 / 기침이 나요.

practice: I've had a fever and a sore throat since yesterday.
subtitle: 여행 중에 몸이 안 좋아서 병원 접수처에서 진료를 신청하는 장면

title: 경찰서 도난 신고
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 기차에서 배낭을 도난당해서 경찰서에 신고하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. I need to report a theft.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Sure. What happened?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Someone took my backpack on the train.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: What time was it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Around nine this morning.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: What does your bag look like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's a black backpack. It has a small blue tag.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: What was inside?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: My laptop, my wallet, and my passport.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Please fill out this form.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you need my hotel number?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Yes. We will call you if we find it.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I have a report number?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Of course. It's on this paper. You should also call your embassy about the passport.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 검은색 배낭이에요. 작은 파란색 태그가 달려 있어요.

meaning.speaker: 경찰
meaning.text: 물론이죠. 이 종이에 적혀 있어요. 여권은 대사관에도 연락해 보세요.

expressions.en: I need to report a theft.
Can I have a report number?

practice: Someone took my backpack on the train.
subtitle: 기차에서 배낭을 도난당해서 경찰서에 신고하는 장면

title: 슈퍼마켓 계산
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 슈퍼마켓 계산대에서 계산하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Hi! Did you find everything okay?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, thank you. Can I have a bag, please?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Sure. A small bag is ten cents.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, one bag, please.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Do you have a membership card?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, I don't. Can I get one today?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Yes, but it takes five minutes. Do you want to wait?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, thanks. Maybe next time.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Okay. Your total is eighteen dollars and fifty cents.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Yes. Please insert your card here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Done. Can I have the receipt?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Here you go. Have a nice day!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 네, 감사합니다. 봉투 하나 주실 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 아니요, 없어요. 오늘 만들 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 다 했어요. 영수증 주실 수 있어요?

expressions.en: Can I have a bag, please?
Do you have a membership card?

practice: Can I pay by card?
subtitle: 슈퍼마켓 계산대에서 계산하는 장면

title: 채식 메뉴
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 식당에서 직원한테 고기 없는 채식 메뉴를 물어보는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Do you have any vegetarian dishes?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, we do. We have veggie pasta and mushroom risotto.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I don't eat meat or fish. Is the risotto okay?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes. It has no meat. It has some cheese.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Cheese is fine. Is the soup made with chicken?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: The tomato soup has no chicken. It's all vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. I'll have the mushroom risotto, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Would you like a salad with that?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, a small salad, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Anything to drink?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Just water, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. It will be ready in ten minutes.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네, 있어요. 채소 파스타랑 버섯 리조또가 있어요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 저는 고기랑 생선을 안 먹어요. 리조또는 괜찮아요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네. 고기는 안 들어가요. 치즈는 조금 들어가요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 토마토 수프에는 닭고기가 없어요. 전부 채소예요.

expressions.en: Do you have any vegetarian dishes?
I don't eat meat or fish.

practice: I don't eat meat or fish. Do you have any vegetarian dishes?
subtitle: 식당에서 직원한테 고기 없는 채식 메뉴를 물어보는 장면

title: 미용실
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 여행 중에 미용실에 가서 머리를 자르는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. Do you have time for a haircut?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, but please wait about twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's fine. I'll wait.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Okay. How would you like your hair?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Short on the sides, and just a little off the top, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me wash your hair first.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Is this length good?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A little shorter on the sides, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: No problem. Please look in the mirror.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It looks great! How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's twenty-five dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here you go. Keep the change.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thank you! Have a nice day.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 옆은 짧게, 위는 조금만 잘라 주세요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 옆을 조금만 더 짧게 해 주세요.

expressions.en: Do you have time for a haircut?
Just a little off the top.

practice: Short on the sides, and just a little off the top, please.
subtitle: 여행 중에 미용실에 가서 머리를 자르는 장면

title: 호텔 조식 문의
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 호텔 프런트에서 조식에 대해 물어보는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is breakfast included with my room?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. It's free for hotel guests.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What time does breakfast start?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's from six thirty to ten o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Where is the restaurant?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's on the second floor, next to the elevator.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What kind of food do you have?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: We have eggs, bread, fruit, and yogurt.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I get coffee, too?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Of course. Coffee and tea are free.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I bring a friend? She isn't staying here.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. It's twelve dollars for her.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's fine. Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Enjoy your breakfast!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 실례합니다, 제 방에 조식이 포함돼 있나요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 친구를 데려와도 돼요? 여기 묵지는 않아요.

expressions.en: What kind of food do you have?

practice: Excuse me, is breakfast included with my room?
subtitle: 호텔 프런트에서 조식에 대해 물어보는 장면

title: 지연된 항공편
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 공항 게이트에서 내 비행기가 지연됐는지 직원한테 물어보는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Is flight 305 to Busan delayed?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. It will leave one hour late.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Why is it late?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: There is bad weather. We are sorry.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What is the new time?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It leaves at 9:40. Boarding starts at 9:10.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I get some food or water?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes. Here is a ten-dollar meal voucher.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. Where can I use it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: You can use it at the café near gate 12.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Please tell me if the time changes.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. We will make an announcement.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네, 맞아요. 한 시간 늦게 출발해요.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 12번 게이트 근처 카페에서 쓸 수 있어요.

practice: Please tell me if the time changes.
subtitle: 공항 게이트에서 내 비행기가 지연됐는지 직원한테 물어보는 장면

title: 와인 시음
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 와이너리에서 와인을 시음하고 마음에 드는 와인을 사는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi! Can we taste some wines today?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure! We have a tasting for fifteen dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What do I get for that?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: You can try four wines. Two red and two white.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Which one is the most popular?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Our red wine. It is a little sweet.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I don't like strong wine. Is it light?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, it is light and easy to drink.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: This white wine is nice. How much is a bottle?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's twenty-four dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'll take two bottles, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Great! Do you want a gift bag?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요! 오늘 와인 시음할 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 그 가격이면 뭘 마셔 볼 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 와인 네 종류를 맛볼 수 있어요. 레드 두 개, 화이트 두 개예요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 저는 센 와인은 안 좋아해요. 가벼워요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 이 화이트 와인 좋네요. 한 병에 얼마예요?

expressions.en: Which one is the most popular?

practice: This white wine is nice. How much is a bottle?
subtitle: 와이너리에서 와인을 시음하고 마음에 드는 와인을 사는 장면

title: 콘서트 표
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 매표소에서 토요일 콘서트 표를 사는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. Do you have tickets for the concert on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Yes, we do. How many tickets do you need?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Two, please. How much are they?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Floor seats are eighty dollars. Balcony seats are fifty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Two balcony seats, please.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Sure. The show starts at eight. The doors open at seven.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I get the tickets on my phone?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Yes. I can send them to your email.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Of course. That's one hundred dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Where is the entrance?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Use Gate B. Please bring your ID.

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 네. 이메일로 보내 드릴 수 있어요.

expressions.en: How many tickets do you need?
Can I get the tickets on my phone?

practice: Two balcony seats, please.
subtitle: 매표소에서 토요일 콘서트 표를 사는 장면

title: 세관 신고
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 공항 세관에서 신고하는지 물어보고 가방을 확인하는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Hello. Do you have anything to declare?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, I don't think so.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: What's in your bag?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Just clothes, some snacks, and gifts for my friends.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Do you have any meat, fruit, or plants?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, I don't. Only candy and tea.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Are you carrying more than ten thousand dollars in cash?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, I only have about two hundred dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Please open your bag for me.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Sure. Here you go.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Okay. Everything looks fine.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. Can I go now?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Yes. Enjoy your trip!

meaning.speaker: 세관원
meaning.text: 현금 만 달러 넘게 갖고 있나요?

expressions.en: Do you have anything to declare?
I only have about ~ in cash.

practice: No, I don't think so. Just clothes and gifts.
subtitle: 공항 세관에서 신고하는지 물어보고 가방을 확인하는 장면

title: 놀이공원 분실물
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 놀이공원 분실물 센터에서 잃어버린 모자를 찾는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. I lost my hat.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: What does it look like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's a blue baseball hat.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Where did you lose it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Maybe near the roller coaster.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Let me check. Please wait a moment.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Is this your hat?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, that's mine! Thank you so much.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Please write your name here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Sure. Do I need to pay anything?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: No, it's free. Have a nice day!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: You too. Thanks again!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 네. 뭐 내야 하는 게 있나요?

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 좋은 하루 보내세요. 다시 한번 감사해요!

expressions.en: Do I need to pay anything?

practice: Excuse me. I lost my hat.
subtitle: 놀이공원 분실물 센터에서 잃어버린 모자를 찾는 장면

title: 호텔 세탁물
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 호텔에 맡긴 셔츠가 안 돌아와서 프런트에 물어보는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. I left my laundry with you yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, sir. Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: My blue shirt isn't in the bag.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. Do you have the receipt?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, here it is. Room 502.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Let me check. One moment, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: We found it. It's still in the laundry room.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oh, good! Can I get it today?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sorry, it's still wet. We can bring it tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Please bring it to my room.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Of course. Is nine o'clock okay?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, that's fine. Thank you!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 아, 다행이다! 오늘 받을 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 죄송해요, 아직 젖어 있어요. 내일 아침에 가져다 드릴게요.

expressions.en: I left my laundry with you.
Please bring it to my room.

practice: Please bring it to my room.
subtitle: 호텔에 맡긴 셔츠가 안 돌아와서 프런트에 물어보는 장면

title: 주유소
intro: 좋은 아침. 오늘은 렌터카로 가다가 주유소에서 기름 넣는 장면이야.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. This is my first time here. Can you help me?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Sure. Which pump are you at?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Pump number three.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Regular or premium?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Regular, please. Fill it up.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: You need to pay first. Card or cash?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Card, please. Can I pay at the pump?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Not today. That pump is broken. Pay here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: OK. Fifty dollars on pump 3, please.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Sure. Do you need anything else?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. Where is the restroom?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Behind the building. Here's the key.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. And a bottle of water, please.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Two dollars. Have a nice trip!

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 안녕하세요. 여기 처음이에요. 도와주실 수 있어요?

meaning.speaker: 직원
meaning.text: 오늘은 안 돼요. 그 주유기는 고장이에요. 여기서 내세요.

meaning.speaker: 나
meaning.text: 고마워요. 그리고 물 한 병 주세요.

expressions.en: Can I pay at the pump?

practice: Regular, please. Fill it up.
subtitle: 렌터카로 가다가 주유소에서 기름 넣는 장면

title: 공원에서 자전거 빌리기
intro: 공원 근처 자전거 대여점에서 하루 동안 자전거를 빌리는 장면.
subtitle: 공원 근처 자전거 대여점에서 하루 동안 자전거를 빌리는 장면

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi! I want to rent a bike.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Sure. For how long?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: For one day. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: It's eight dollars an hour, or thirty dollars for a day.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'll take the day pass, please.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you have an ID?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, here is my passport.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Thanks. A helmet and a lock are included.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. When do I need to return it?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Please bring it back by six o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No problem. Do you have a map of the park?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.text: Yes, here you go. Have a nice ride!

expressions.en: I want to rent a bike.
I'll take the day pass, please.
A helmet and a lock are included.
Please bring it back by six o'clock.

practice: I'll take the day pass, please.
